loadFailed: The documents could not be loaded.
downloadFailed: The document could not be downloaded.
viewFailed: The document could not be opened.
viewBlocked: The browser blocked the new tab. Allow pop-ups or use Download.

sections.dossierHint: These documents apply to the dossier as a whole and can be consulted from every order and activity. If a document belongs to one order or activity, upload it at that level.
sections.ownHint: Documents that belong to order {number} only.
sections.generalHint: The same documents as on the dossier level, no copies. View and download only here.
sections.ownActivityHint: Documents that belong to activity {label} only.

empty.order: No documents for this order yet.
empty.general: This dossier has no dossier documents.
empty.activity: No documents for this activity yet.

visibility.independent: Customer visibility is independent of the level: moving a document never makes it visible or internal.
visibility.title: Change visibility
visibility.confirmVisible: The customer will then be able to view and download this document in the customer portal.
visibility.confirmInternal: The document disappears from the customer portal and can only be consulted internally.
visibility.failed: The visibility could not be changed.
visibility.nowVisible: The document is now visible in the customer portal.
visibility.nowInternal: The document is no longer visible to the customer.

upload.title: Upload document
upload.targetHint: Choose the level the document belongs to. A dossier document applies to the whole dossier.
upload.fileHint: PDF, JPG or PNG, 10 MB maximum.
upload.customerVisibleHint: Documents are internal by default. Only tick this to show the document in the customer portal.
upload.retryHint: The document details are already in the dossier. Pick another file if needed and try again, or remove the document.
upload.removed: The document without a file was removed.
upload.createFailed: The document could not be created.
upload.fileFailed: The document details were saved, but the file was NOT uploaded: {reason}
upload.fileFailedFallback: The file could not be uploaded.

fileProblem.tooLarge: The file is larger than 10 MB.
fileProblem.unsupportedType: Only PDF, JPG and PNG files are allowed.

move.title: Move document to…
move.intro: Choose the level "{title}" belongs to from now on.
move.explanation: The file itself stays the same: only the link changes. Customer visibility does not change.
move.failed: The document could not be moved.

delete.title: Delete document
delete.confirmDossier: Are you sure you want to delete "{title}"? This dossier document applies to the whole dossier and will be removed everywhere.
delete.confirmOrder: Are you sure you want to delete "{title}"? This document belongs to order {number} only and will be deleted permanently.
delete.failed: The document could not be deleted.
delete.confirmActivity: Are you sure you want to delete "{title}"? This document belongs to activity {label} only and will be deleted permanently.

issued.title: Transport documents
issued.loadFailed: The transport documents could not be loaded.
issued.pdfFailed: The PDF could not be downloaded.
issued.failed: The transport document could not be created.
issued.failedRetry: {reason} Try again: a repeated attempt never produces a second number.
